programme.desc: Buon Appetito. Ina creates a classic Italian Bolognese, but she updates it to be an easy weeknight dinner. Then, she makes a traditional Tuscan roasted sausage and grapes dish. S5, Ep3

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Market Day. Ina is inspired by local produce and embraces the incredible ingredients that she can find on her doorstep. She makes honey vanilla pound cake and corn and Brie salad. S5, Ep4

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Make It Fast. Ina shows how to make two tasty main-course ideas quickly. The perfect ideas for dinner parties; roasted salmon with green herbs and chicken with shallots. S5, Ep5

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Post Cards From Paris. Ina enjoys a day of cooking her favourite French meals, including an omelette and veal chops with Roquefort butter and potato basil purée. S5, Ep6

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Barefoot Contessa Burger Joint. Ina makes burgers with a twist. She gives the sides a makeover with a buttermilk ranch dressing on bibb lettuce and sweet potato chips. S5, Ep7

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: How The Cookie Crumbles. Ina bakes a double delicious treat - chocolate chunk blondies and cookies using one easy batter. Plus, Patti Page shows Ina how to make animal cookies. S5, Ep8

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Just Candy. Ina hits the sweet spot with her favourite candy recipes, including squishy marshmallows and white chocolate bark. Then she makes a warming squash soup. S5, Ep9

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Shake It Up. Ina prepares three easy canapes that are perfect for the holiday season including, salmon tartare. Also, mixologist Brian Van Flandern makes two delicious cocktails. S5, Ep10

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Miguel While You Were Out. Ina cooks for her friend, Miguel Flores-Vianaa. She makes panko-crusted salmon, warm French lentils, an all-American cheeseboard and chicken noodle soup. S6, Ep1

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Drill Dinner. Ina serves a delicious dinner at the fire station for hungry firefighters after a practice drill. She makes beef barley soup, sloppy Joes and pecan caramel sundaes. S6, Ep2

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James arrives in the tiny village of Giverny, known for its food and art. He explores Monet's kitchen and cooks up an autumnal treat of apple doughnuts. S1, Ep17

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James ventures to Paris, one of his favourite cities in the world! He cooks duck breast with tangy vegetables, a steak baguette and gin and cucumber savarin. S1, Ep18

programme.title: Hairy Bikers Comfort Food
programme.desc: The Bikers create their version of hearty pub classics. They give a new look to a traditional pudding and reveal the secrets behind the ultimate fishcake. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Hairy Bikers Comfort Food
programme.desc: The Bikers cook dishes that will bring smiles to the table. They make their epic biker burger, a show-stopping meringue, and a modern take on a classic banana split. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Hairy Bikers Comfort Food
programme.desc: The Bikers use top-notch ingredients to create amazing dishes. They update the classic rum baba and use a great cut of beef in a traditional Greek stifado. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Hairy Bikers Comfort Food
programme.desc: The Bikers get nostalgic with recipes to conjure up happy memories. They make a Lancashire hotpot like Dave's mum used to make, and a French speciality for Si. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Long Island. Adam Richman is on Long Island, New York, for a massive plate of Italian food, a colossal gelato sundae and the Davey Jones' Locker Challenge. S2, Ep28

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Oklahoma City. Adam Richman is in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, for a presidential T-bone steak, the Sooner State original fried onion burger and a Fried Catfish Challenge. S2, Ep29

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Italy
programme.desc: Bari. Adam's in Bari tasting the most iconic foods named after this city, including focaccia Barese and a local seafood dish called tiella Barese. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Italy
programme.desc: Rome. Adam's in Rome tasting the most iconic foods named after this city, including pasta dish cacio e pepe, and porchetta Romana: suckling pig Rome style. S1, Ep10

programme.title: New: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Flavortown Finds. Guy Fieri's getting into major flavour with bagels in Gainesville, crawfish and oysters in Baton Rouge, and pastrami and gnocchi in Naples. S41, Ep5

programme.title: New: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Sandwich Shenanigans. Guy Fieri's digging into big-time barbecue in Dallas, tries a spot-on Cubano in Gainesville, and eats a rocking po'boy in Baton Rouge. S41, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Bird, Belly And Beef. Guy Fieri seeks out flavourful meat! He checks out Mexican pork sandwiches in Memphis, Tennessee, and rich short ribs in St. Simons Island, Georgia. S38, Ep16

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Meat And Heat. On a trip to Houston, Guy stops by a barbecue joint that's cooking brisket tacos and jalapeno sausage. Plus, he tries bulgogi at a Korean spot in Tennessee. S34, Ep13

programme.desc: 1998. Drama. Directed by David Skynner. Stars Orla Brady, Robert Cavanah & Peter Davison. An adaptation of Emily Brontë's timeless tale of a love so powerful that it reaches beyond the grave.

programme.title: The Big Bluff
programme.desc: 1955. Thriller. Directed by W. Lee Wilder. Stars John Bromfield, Martha Vickers & Robert Hutton. A rich, but terminally ill, young woman marries a man who plans to kill her for her fortune.

programme.title: Budgie
programme.desc: Sunset mansions. Stars: Adam Faith, Iain Cuthbertson & Lynn Dalby. Budgie joins the world of show business after meeting Janey and Denzil.

programme.title: The Place of the Dead
programme.desc: 1997. Adventure. Directed by Suri Krishnamma. Stars Greg Wise, Simon Dutton & Dougray Scott. A group of soldiers on a British Army expedition attempt to navigate an unexplored Malaysian gully.

programme.title: The High Terrace
programme.desc: 1956. Mystery. Director: Henry Cass. Stars Dale Robertson, Lois Maxwell & Derek Bond. An actress is assisted by an American playwright after her scissors are found lodged in her producer's back.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: The Bride Possessed. 1959. Stars Virginia Leith, Skip Homeier & Harry Townes. Matt Conroy is startled when on their honeymoon his wife Sally suddenly is a determined woman, who denies knowing him.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. Client: Peter Warren. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Undercover Girl
programme.desc: 1958. Crime Drama. A reporter on the verge of exposing a drugs ring is killed before he can write the story. Stars Paul Carpenter and Jackie Collins.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout March.

programme.title: Algiers
programme.desc: 1938. Drama. Directed by John Cromwell. Stars Charles Boyer, Hedy Lamarr & Sigrid Gurie. A wanted jewel thief hiding in the Casbah meets a beautiful woman who makes him long for an escape.

programme.title: And The Same To You
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy starring Sid James, Brian Rix, Leo Franklyn, Tommy Cooper and Vera Day. The boxing-mad nephew of a pious clergyman embarks on an elaborate plan to keep his boxing career a secret.

programme.title: The Mark of Cain
programme.desc: 1947. Crime Drama. Directed by Brian Desmond Hurst. Stars Eric Portman, Sally Gray & Patrick Holt. A young French girl instigates rivalry between two brothers when she marries the younger one.

programme.title: Look At Life Fings Are Getting Smaller
programme.desc: 1964. A fascinating look at how everything is being reduced in size to fit in with the new compact age.

programme.title: The Price of Silence
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: Montgomery Tully. Stars Gordon Jackson, June Thorburn & Mary Clare. Roger forges a new life for himself after his release from prison. But his past catches up with him.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: With Menaces - Part 1. 1974. Stars Basil Henson, Jonathan Elsom & Richard Wilson. A landlord is accused of demanding money with menaces from a number of illegal immigrants.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: With Menaces - Part 2. 1974. Stars Basil Henson, Jonathan Elsom & Richard Wilson. A fisherman tells the court that the landlord asked him to bring in eight immigrants, but Mr. Aslam never paid.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: With Menaces - Part 3. 1974. Stars Basil Henson, Jonathan Elsom & Richard Wilson. Mr. Aslam is forced to explain a two-year jail sentence he served and he admits what the money owed was for.

programme.title: The Happiest Days of Your Life
programme.desc: 1950. Comedy. Directed by Frank Launder. Stars Alastair Sim, Margaret Rutherford & John Turnbull. Chaos ensues for staff and students when an all-boys and an all-girls school are merged into one.

programme.title: Look At Life Digging Up the Past
programme.desc: 1964. A remarkable view of an archaeological dig by both professionals and amateurs to discover ancient Roman remains.

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: Nella Jones/Millboro. 1994. A look at the story of American - Maureen Williamson, who unravelled the secrets of her past life and psychic detective Nella Jones talks about her amazing powers.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: A Family Gathering. 1973. Stars Jean Anderson, Patrick O'Connell & Mark McManus. Mary returns from her recuperation trip abroad. Meanwhile, an offer is put in for land adjoining the Hammond depot.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: The Sound of Death. 1958. Stars Donald Gray, Diana Decker & Gilbert Winfield. On his first holiday in two years, Mark Saber finds himself involved in a murder.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 27. 1975. Sheila Southern performs 'Sing', and Terry Lightfoot and his band perform four numbers. Pat Mooney, Wee Willie Harris and Stu Francis also feature.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: 1989. Drama. Director: Michael Caton-Jones. Stars John Hurt, Joanne Whalley & Bridget Fonda. An affair between an exotic dancer and the Minister of War shakes up the British government.

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: Tomorrow the Rat. 1970. Stars John Paul, Simon Oates & Joby Blanshard. A species of genetically engineered rats, with increased intelligence and a thirst for blood, escape into London.

programme.title: A Good Read: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Gloria Scott. Enjoy this classic short story read by Mike Read in which an old friend of Sherlock's comes to him for help regarding a visit his father received by seaman from his past.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Woman Least Likely - Part 1. 1974. Stars David Ashford, William Mervyn & William Simons. Irene Rutland is in court facing charges of theft, criminal damage and wounding a police officer.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Woman Least Likely - Part 2. 1974. Stars Katharine Blake, David Troughton & Sara Clee. Linda Brightson accuses the defendant of taking her handbag but Mrs Rutland denies the charge.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Woman Least Likely - Part 3. 1974. Stars Griffith Jones, William Marlowe & David Ashford. Bryan Hodge admits that after the death of Irene's husband, she began to drink alcohol after work.

programme.title: Double X
programme.desc: 1992. Crime drama with Bernard Hill and Norman Wisdom. Former petty thief and safecracker Arthur is the 'brains' behind 'The Organisation' but he wants out.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: 1963. Who Killed Purity Mather? Directed Walter Grauman. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. A practicing witch sends Amos a message predicting her murder with a list of five suspects.

programme.title: Law Of The Plainsman
programme.desc: 1960. Rabbit's Fang. Stars Michael Ansara, Don Dubbins & Constance Ford. Sam becomes involved in a conflict with a gunfighter and a greedy husband.

programme.title: The Black Rider
programme.desc: 1954. Directed by Wolf Rilla and starring Jimmy Hanley, Rona Anderson and Lionel Jeffries. A local reporter discovers a group of enemy agents, but will the story get him promotion?

programme.title: Nearest and Dearest
programme.desc: 1972. Comedy. Directed by John Robins. Stars Hylda Baker, Jimmy Jewel & Edward Malin. After their father's death, two siblings inherit a decrepit pickle factory and attempt to keep it afloat.

programme.title: The Hostages
programme.desc: 1975. Family. Directed by David Eady. Stars Stephen Garlick, Ray Barrett & Robin Askwith. A group of children find themselves held hostage by two escaped convicts from a nearby prison.

programme.title: Crooks In Cloisters
programme.desc: 1964. Comedy. Director: Jeremy Summers. Stars Barbara Windsor, Bernard Cribbins, Melvyn Hayes. After pulling off the smallest train robbery, Little Walter and his crew decide to get out of London.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Candidate for Murder. 1961. Directed by David Villiers. Stars Michael Gough, Erika Remberg & John Justin. Kersten, a professional killer, is brought in by a jealous husband to kill his wife.

programme.title: The Boys
programme.desc: 1962. Crime drama starring Richard Todd, Robert Morley, Dudley Sutton & Jess Conrad. When a nightwatchman is murdered, four young men are put on trial. Cleverly directed by Sidney J. Furie.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: It's time to move with Vince Taylor as he performs Whole Lotta Twisting.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Intent to Defraud. 1960. Stars John Ireland, Joseph O'Conor & Philip Latham. When an aging playwright dies of a seizure, Hunter investigates to discover whether it was an accident or a murder.

programme.title: Tarnished Heroes
programme.desc: 1961. War. Directed by Ernest Morris. Stars Dermot Walsh & Patrick McAlinney. Major Bell and a ragtag team undertake a dangerous mission to destroy a bridge of strategic importance to the enemy.

programme.title: Food Flash Chester Orange Juice
programme.desc: 1945. In this charming short video Charlie Chester promotes the importance of orange juice for children under five.

programme.title: Bombay Waterfront
programme.desc: 1952. Directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley, Patricia Dainton and Peter Gawthorne. Follows Temple's efforts to aid the police in solving a series of gruesome murders.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Full Remission. 1962. Stars Stratford Johns, Diane Aubrey & Douglas Cummings. Two people are robbed at gun point, but Chief Inspector Barlow is suspicious about the cash that was stolen.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is back this week to introduce the next episode of Supernatural, in which Lady Sybil is seeing ghosts!

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.desc: Lady Sybil. 1977. Stars Cathleen Nesbitt, Denholm Elliott & John Osborne. Lady Sybil is frightened of a Phantom, she wonders if the ghost of her dead husband haunts the grounds.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Prepare for a night of mad scientists, monsters and murder because next up, Caroline Munro introduces a 1959 horror film: The Manster.

programme.title: The Manster
programme.desc: 1959. Horror. Director: George P. Breakston. Stars Peter Dyneley, Jane Hylton & Tetsu Nakamura. A journalist is given a mysterious injection that turns him into a murderous monster.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: As the end of the night approaches, Caroline Munro is here to give you an insight into what is to come next week at the Cellar Club.

programme.title: Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense
programme.desc: Czech Mate. 1984. Stars Susan George, Patrick Mower & Peter Vaughan. Vicky goes to Prague with her ex-husband but soon finds herself alone, penniless and caught up in a murder.

programme.title: Twilight's Last Gleaming
programme.desc: 1977. Thriller. Directed by Robert Aldrich. Stars Burt Lancaster, Richard Widmark & Roscoe Lee Browne. An imprisoned rogue Air Force general seizes a nuclear silo and threatens to start WWIII.

programme.title: Star of My Night
programme.desc: 1954. Romance. Directed by Paul Dickson. Stars Griffth Jones, Kathleen Byron & Hugh Williams. A cynical sculptor becomes inspired by a ballerina he meets, but this only enrages her jealous lover.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Romney Marsh/Pumpkins. 1986. Jack looks back at a sunny visit to Kent when he tried to photograph a 'flying frog' on Romney Marsh, and he visits a village pumpkin fair.

programme.title: Dick Tracy Vs Cueball
programme.desc: 1946. Thriller. Director: Gordon Douglas. Stars Morgan Conway, Dick Wessel & Esther Howard. Dick Tracy is on the trail of the rampaging arch nemesis, Cueball.

programme.title: The Black Arrow
programme.desc: The Stake. 1974. Stars Roberta Tovey, Brian Coburn & Simon Cuff. Lady Ann is put on the stand to determine whether she is guilty of witchcraft, but will Black Arrow return and save the day?

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. When the two strange boys arrive in his realm, King Nerada worries about the fulfilment of ancient prophecies.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Magic Book. 1956. Stars William Russell, Ronald Leigh-Hunt & Cyril Smith. Sir Lancelot helps to keep safe an Abbey and the occupants from invaders.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Duo Defy. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. Mr. Freeze gives Professor Isaacson an ultimatum: meet his demands, or he will begin to freeze the entire country.

programme.title: The Roy Rogers Show
programme.desc: Outcasts of Paradise Valley. 1955. Stars Roy Rogers, Trigger & Dale Evans. Unable to find a job, two young men decide on a life of crime. Their first victims are an elderly couple.

programme.title: Captain Scarlet and the Mysterons
programme.desc: Big Ben Strikes Again. 1967. Stars Sylvia Anderson, Donald Gray & Janna Hill. The Mysterons announce they intend to destroy London and a truck carrying an atomic device goes missing in the city.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Young Widow. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Having escaped from Gessler's troops, Tell and his wife are given refuge by the beautiful Countess von Marheim.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Hand of the Hawk. 1956. Stars Robert Shaw, Anthony Dawson & Sid James. Tempest tries to solve the murder of a crew member from another ship. A mysterious clue may just hold the answer.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Traitor. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. King John fails to gather money to release Richard, some Lords raise the money. Robin must secretly get it out the country.

programme.title: The Rescue Squad
programme.desc: 1963. Family. Directed by Colin Bell. Stars Christopher Brett, Shirley Joy & Peter Butterworth. A group of children attempt to retrieve their toy plane from the top of an abandoned tower.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: 24 Hours. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Robert Arden & Joy Owen. In Piccadilly, Maguire spots Caldwell, a criminal he once arrested in Canada; he has a hunch that he is up to no good and follows him.

programme.title: The Ship That Died of Shame
programme.desc: (AKA PT Raiders) 1955. Thriller. Director Basil Dearden. Stars Richard Attenborough, George Baker and Bill Owen. A trio of ex-servicemen begin smuggling black market items into post-war Britain.

programme.title: The Great Game (1945)
programme.desc: 1945. A short documentary about football. This film explores everything football such as teaching school children football techniques, scouting the next professional players and nationwide matches!

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Dutchman's Reef. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Anthony Wickert & Leonard Teale. Mrs. Culbert summons Cobb to search for her missing son but he is not interested until they come to an agreement.

programme.title: The Long Arm
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Charles Frend. Stars Jack Hawkins, John Stratton, Dorothy Alison & Michael Brooke. The sleuths of Scotland Yard try to solve a series of burglaries.

programme.title: Look At Life High, Wide and Faster
programme.desc: 1963. A captivating look at the plans for closer co-ordination between our roads, railways and coastal shipping.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Trap. 1962. Stars Rupert Davies, Sonia Dresdel & Jacqueline Hill. Maigret creates a trap to capture a serial killer who is targeting women in the streets of Montmartre.

programme.title: The Odessa File
programme.desc: 1974. Thriller. Directed by Ronald Neame. Stars Jon Voight, Maximillian Schell & Maria Schell. A reporter tries to track down a number of SS officers who mysteriously vanished after the war.

programme.title: Strip Tease Murder
programme.desc: 1961. Crime. Director: Ernest Morris. Stars John Hewer, Ann Lynn & Jean Muir. A dancer collapses and dies on stage at the famous Flamingo Club leading her husband to delve into the investigation.
